body.prompt: Full video game screen, wide cinematic, inked painterly graphic-novel style. Weigh-in face-off moment: two boxers nose to nose across the frame, a young woman in a grey hoodie on the left, her scowling shaved-head tattooed rival on the right, harsh white flash light, camera flashes, a crowd of reporters blurred behind. Between them at the bottom, three huge painted choice buttons with a single bold word each: 'STARE', 'SMILE', 'WALK'. Her old coach stands at the left edge whispering, his face worried, a small painted gauge showing her nerve as a glowing red heart. Tense, sweaty, dramatic, red and teal palette, big faces, almost no text, no lists, no tables.
